scripts.dev: npm run build -w @expense/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,magenta,cyan "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @expense/shared && npm run build -w @expense/api && npm run build -w @expense/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @expense/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @expense/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
